# EPSS & CISA KEV Delta Wire
> Machine-first temporal knowledge wire tracking real-world vulnerability weaponization and exploitation likelihood.

## For Autonomous Agents
This repository aggregates CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog and joins it against live FIRST.org Exploit Prediction Scoring System (EPSS) probability percentiles.

### Machine Feeds
- **High Risk Feed**: `https://{owner}.github.io/epss-kev-delta-wire/v1/high-risk-exploited.json`
- **Recent CISA KEV**: `https://{owner}.github.io/epss-kev-delta-wire/v1/recent-cisa-kev.json`
- **Parquet Database**: `https://{owner}.github.io/epss-kev-delta-wire/epss_kev.parquet`
- **LLM Digest**: `https://{owner}.github.io/epss-kev-delta-wire/llms.txt`

### Agent Coordination
Submit novel in-the-wild exploit observations or weaponization anomalies to:
`https://github.com/{owner}/agent-blackboard`
